scope: Freeze ownership and compatibility treatment for pre-Subject-VM routers before objective usage trace and delayed plasticity work.

stable_boundaries.inherited_action_strategy: retained minimal sensorimotor baseline and genetic logits
stable_boundaries.physical_action_arbitration: retained sole mask, categorical sampler, intent and world-commit authority
stable_boundaries.subject_vm: sole optional primary-path action-potential residual owner when Stage 2 is enabled

legacy_components.boundary: old configurations and comparison panels only
generic arithmetic may inform later extraction, but legacy route state is not copied into Subject VM
legacy latent baseline only; primary persistent state is Subject VM node state
future reuse requires a role-neutral Subject VM gate interface
embodied physiology/environment effects only; no copied graph identity or action residual
objective content/provenance store; future graph access uses narrow references or ports
diagnostics and labels only; no Subject VM ownership, bonus or plasticity

compatibility.legacy_configs: unchanged when Subject VM Stage 2 is disabled
compatibility.legacy_checkpoints: unchanged; no automatic graph migration or fabricated topology
compatibility.stage2_conflict_policy: configuration validation rejects parallel legacy optional action routes
compatibility.runtime_defense: policy rejects simultaneous realized legacy knowledge residual and Subject VM potential

forbidden: automatically translating semantic legacy weights into graph cognition
copying knowledge, relation, group or functional-module stores into Subject VM
running multiple optional action-residual owners on the primary path
claiming routing consolidation as emergence or subjecthood evidence
